the rutile content in the TiO2 powder prepared by vapor phase reaction is mainly controlled by the reaction temperature.
the rutile TiO2 powder was prepared successfully by vapor phase reaction at 1000∼1100 °C, and the particle size decreased with the increasing reaction temperature.

rutile TiO2 powders with high purity and fine particles can be obtained at temperatures higher than 1100 °C.

the reaction of TiCl 4 with H 2 O in the presence of CO 2 produces TiO 2 in high yield, and the reaction is selective for rutile.
